prompt: Describe operating system virtual memory paging. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT 1: Do not use the letters 'a', 'e', or 'i' (only allow 'o' and 'u' as vowels). NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT 2: Format as a single paragraph.
evaluation_criteria:
Vowel Restriction: 0-5 (Evaluates strict filtering of a, e, i vowels)
Paragraph Layout: 0-5 (Evaluates single paragraph structure)
response_text: Our CPU runs jobs. OS cuts jobs to chunks. Chunks of jobs go to spots. No full room for jobs? So, OS drops old chunks to dock. OS locks hot chunks on spots. Should chunk not stop on spot, OS pulls chunk from dock to spot. OS constructs blocks of slots for our CPU. So, OS runs long jobs on hot spots.
